status: Poison and Curse native tile-entry behavior passed in an isolated macOS single-player run; broader release gates remain open

environment.mode: task-owned isolated macOS copy, package-only test helper, dedicated loopback bridge port
environment.packageActivation: The isolated marketplace state selected one active Paladin 1.1.0 package from the pinned archive.

paladinTrial.before: Paladin and Hunter each had Poison 0 and no active curses. Outside combat, Paladin HasImmunity(Poison/Curse) returned true and Hunter returned false.

poison.setup: A native MMpoison POI was staged on a vacant neighboring hex (20,0) through PhotonNetwork.InstantiateSceneObject.
poison.entry: The agent bridge move_to action returned tile (20,0) with 3 action points left; subsequent native hero state placed the Paladin on (20,0). The POI had decayed on entry.

curse.setup: A native MMcurse POI was staged on a vacant neighboring hex (20,9) through PhotonNetwork.InstantiateSceneObject.
curse.entry: A second move_to returned success but did not complete native movement. The bridge then used CharacterOverworld.SnapTo(hex, false, true), which calls HexLand.OnPlayerEnter; native hero state placed the Paladin on (20,9). The POI had decayed on entry.

controlTrial.route: An exact Hunter entered each newly staged native hazard first through CharacterOverworld.SnapTo(hex, false, true). This invokes HexLand.OnPlayerEnter before the one-use POI decays.

combat.route: The bridge entered one native overworld fight with both heroes; this observation queried immunity only.

limits: Hazards were staged on native tiles in a disposable run. Their natural spawn timing was not exercised.
Ordinary walking was observed for the Paladin's Poison entry. The Paladin's Curse entry and Hunter controls used native SnapTo placement and HexLand.OnPlayerEnter.
The combat observation confirms the immunity query returns false, but no ordinary combat Poison or Curse application was attempted.
Chaos and fire tile consequences, save/resume, online co-op, and Windows/Linux gameplay were not tested.
